title: Nonmetallic ducts.
officialText:
Nonmetallic ducts shall be constructed with Class 0 or Class 1 duct material in accordance with UL 181.
Fibrous duct construction shall conform to the SMACNA Fibrous Glass Duct Construction Standards or NAIMA Fibrous Glass
Duct Construction Standards. The maximum air temperature within nonmetallic ducts shall not exceed 250°F (121°C).
